# netactuate_os_images (Data Source)

Reads Os Images visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_os_images" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `os_images` (List of Object) List of available operating system images (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--os_images))
